summary: Plan v4 for task 553: route (3), Massacci-style subtractive blocking with a completeness-only redirect channel, 12 phases / ~36 hours, at FULL branchSatisfiableIn s4FC strength per the user's independent choice. v3 stamped [ABANDONED] with a Superseded-by pointer while preserving its Phase 1 [COMPLETED] status and four measurements verbatim. The plan front-loads the route's ONE load-bearing risk by SPLITTING it into two independent, standalone, driver-free, cheaply-falsifiable decision gates that run in PARALLEL as wave 2 (phase 2 = consumption / truth lemma; phase 3 = establishment / forward-cone transfer), each with an explicit written kill criterion, and by forbidding a sorry at either gate -- because this task has twice died on a sorry standing in for a possibly-false statement, and because v3's 1374/1374 measurement did not survive contact with a general proof obligation. Three plan-time findings changed the design relative to report 04 section 7.2's pricing, each derived by reading the source in this planning run rather than assumed. (1) REFUTATION: the cheapest design -- reusing modalHintikkaSetS4 verbatim at acc union red -- is exactly the (b)/(d) statement with 40 measured counterexamples, because conjunct 2 evaluates modalApplyOneS4 against whatever acc it is handed. The predicate is therefore BIFURCATED. (2) SAVING: Accessibility is a bare edge list, so extractModelS4 and its five lemmas are reused verbatim and no extractModelS4Sub exists, removing roughly one of report 04's estimated phases. (3) MANDATORY hypothesis-weakening: the six hintikkaS4 bridges must be generalized to the bare saturation conjunct, since conjuncts 3/4 over bare acc are false for this driver. Two corrections to inherited claims are recorded: the S5 apply-parametric ladder is a TEMPLATE not a drop-in (the Gen lemmas are stated over modalTableauGen, which threads neither keys nor red), and v3's asserted repo axiom count of 26 does not reproduce (measured 47 raw matches), so the plan requires a per-phase captured baseline instead of a hard-coded number. One architectural constraint was discovered: ModalTableauResult is read-only (8 consumers, carries only (b, acc)), so phase 7 carries two pre-designed options for surfacing `red` at the leaf. 12 preserved assets are tabulated with dispositions, including v3's inherited probe, report 04's three probes as harnesses to EXTEND rather than replace, the guard byte-for-byte unchanged, and the user-retained sorry. The postmortem section names the structural property that prevents a fourth recurrence -- the edge is never added to acc, so the obligation leaves the soundness-tracked structure rather than being justified inside it -- and makes it falsifiable by a grep test that phase 8 must run and record.
